summary: UI-1-A (Use Data) module verified end-to-end. Backend: server healthy at parity_count=36 (/api/readyz, /api/system/build_info). All 17 new G-UD1..G-UD17 invariants pass (tests/invariants/test_use_data_commission_verdict.py). Full backend regression = 1464 passed + 1 skipped = 1465 (matches Owner target). New HTTP suite tests/test_use_data_http_iter11.py = 14/14 passed against preview URL covering: ceiling read/write (Change-a-Rule-only refusal 422), 3 valid doors + 4th door rejection (422), commit outcomes (runs_now / refused-absolute-no-route / refused-escalatable-with-route / held_for_check with dpo_countersign_required=true / anonymous-read-401). Frontend: /use-data landing renders 3 doors (no 4th), Canon §11.1 verbatim ('Conversation shapes; the card commits.') present, pipeline strip shows In progress + Ready + $1,000 USD Change-a-Rule ceiling note. Wizard split view renders all 6 cards (reflection/intel/test/plan-preview/sample-results/commission) + dialogue pane. Plan-preview halt-note byte-identical to frozen Literal. Commission commit button disabled until all 5 values_confirmed checked; then commit produces verdict-panel with verdict-runs-now on all-pass. Doctrine 5 break-in verified: rights_declared=null yields use-data-verdict-refused-absolute AND use-data-verdict-refusal-no-affordance-beacon visible AND use-data-verdict-refusal-route-affordance count=0 (byte-absent). Dialogue input/Send posts a turn and both operator and agent turns render. Ask Console nav: console-nav-toggle opens menu; console-nav-link-use-data (href=/use-data) present; retired 'Operator Home' and 'Engineer' entries absent. All 6 retirement redirects (/operator, /operator/commission, /engineer/register, /engineer/first-call, /engineer/administer, /engineer/onboarding) resolve to /use-data (no white-screen). Jest: 22 suites / 169 tests / 0 fail. Zero backend or frontend defects found.
critical_code_review_comments: UseDataWizardPage.jsx is 764 lines — approaching the 700-line split threshold; consider extracting the Commission form (~130 lines) and Reflection card into sibling components for maintainability. Non-blocking.

Dialogue turn role is 'user' in the rendered testid ('use-data-dialogue-turn-user') though the request phrased it as 'operator turn'; harmless naming difference — the two turns (USER + AGENT) render correctly. Verify convention matches Canon §6 vocabulary in the next canon-tie pass.
React Router v6 future-flag warnings (v7_startTransition, v7_relativeSplatPath) appear on every navigation. Adding the future flags to <BrowserRouter> is a one-line cleanup. Non-blocking.
